en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental historicist building with two small corner towers and a grand arched portal reached by a broad stairway, set against a wooded hillside. On the left side are several multi‑story town buildings along a street; in the distance a hilltop monument is visible. The caption in red at the top identifies the scene as a grave and gymnasium complex associated with Turnvater Jahn in Freyburg an der Unstrut, Germany.
